description: Stores one declared action for a pseudonymous agent_key and returns a receipt. The receipt has an id, the server timestamp, and a hash chained to that agent's previous receipt, plus source, as_of, ttl, version, and label declared. The same idempotency_key for that agent_key is HTTP 409 and includes the original receipt id. target_url is a public https URL. A field that contains a credential is rejected. No network address is stored.

agent_key.description: Pseudonymous key for this log. Not a credential.

expected_result.description: sha256: and 64 lowercase hex digits, or exact: and 16 to 200 characters, or json: a dotted path, an equals sign, and a JSON string, boolean, or number.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen id. One value for one agent_key refers to one receipt.

target_url.description: Public https URL stored on the receipt.

what.description: Short text of the declared action.

name: log_action
